=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:855-859, 1740-1744, 2350-2354 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The checkouts in analyze-commit-notify, deep-audit and api-redundancy pass `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` without `persist-credentials: false`, so GH_PAT is stored in `.git/config`, and the later fetch/push calls (around 1605-1619, 2267, 2868) use that stored credential instead of a one-shot env helper.
  WHY: GH_PAT stays on disk for the rest of each job, where later steps, including LLM-driven Codex steps, can read it; this breaks §23.E and does not match the deliver-report checkout at line 2944, which sets `persist-credentials: false`, or the other workflows in the repo, which set it too.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2215-2962 (also scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:246-247) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `audit_status=completed` (line 2215) and `api_redundancy_status=completed` (line 2816) are set before the "Commit and push" section steps run, and deliver-report reads them as AUDIT_STATUS/API_REDUNDANCY_STATUS (lines 2961-2962), so the PR body says "completed" even when the section push failed.
  WHY: If the push fails with reason=push_failed or reason=push_rejected_by_ruleset, deliver-report still runs because of always() and claims the run branch has a section it does not have, which misleads reviewers. Severity disagreement: gemini says MAJOR; sonnet, minimax, luna and glm say NIT. The highest (MAJOR) is used. Fix: pass needs.<job>.result and print "completed" only when the result is success.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:297 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `gh pr create` uses `TARGET_BRANCH` (GITHUB_REF_NAME) as the base instead of the repository default branch.
  WHY: A workflow dispatched from a feature branch opens the report PR against that branch instead of `main`.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2953-2962; scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:65-83 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The deliver-report env block does not pass DEFAULT_BRANCH, and the script never checks that GITHUB_REF_NAME equals the default branch; TARGET_BRANCH is set at line 70 and used as `--base` at line 297.
  WHY: A dispatch from a non-default branch opens the report PR into an unrelated branch. A fail-closed `reason=run_context_invalid` check is needed, as LINKED ISSUE Approach §2 expects.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:198-234 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script does not check that the run branch contains only the report file (for example, it would not catch scripts/evil.sh).
  WHY: Malicious or accidental changes on the run branch could reach a PR against the protected default branch and bypass isolation.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:171-185 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After `git worktree add --detach` (line 171), the script never checks that the run branch only changes paths matching WLA_DELIVER_DOC_RE; the documented `reason=unexpected_paths` fail-closed check is missing.
  WHY: The run branch is written by Codex; a stray path would reach the default-branch PR with only `ai-review/head-gate` in the way. Fix: `git diff --no-renames --name-only HEAD "${run_ref}"` plus a per-name regex match.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:118-133 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When the paginated PR listing fails, the script logs `degraded` and continues with an empty list of other PRs.
  WHY: After a transient listing failure, an existing PR with a conflicting report filename is not detected, so a second PR is opened and conflicts later.
- tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:53 (CI on PR head a46d55d99e13: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, orchestrate-poll (2)) | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Three failures do not map to any hunk in this PR: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, orchestrate-poll (2), and the pre-push gate's claim that test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py fails "caused by this change". workflow-log-analysis.yml is already in ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS at line 53.
  WHY: The required `lint` gate fails on this head and blocks merge; the editor must compare these jobs against the merge-base and not guess-fix. Severity disagreement: sonnet says NIT, glm says MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:93-95 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The one-shot GIT_CONFIG_* credential helper is exported for the script's whole lifetime and inherited by every subprocess, not only the git invocations that need it.
  WHY: This is a hardening gap only, since no current subprocess misuses it; any tool added later would silently inherit the credential helper.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff has no hunk in docs/INVENTORY.md, lines 382-383 are still consecutive, and CI shows `FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh` and `FAIL: agents.md:2011: references scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`, so tests-release-and-log-analysis fails and the required `lint` check fails. The earlier editor fix was lost (editor_changes_lost, run 43034466917), and docs/INVENTORY.md is outside the files_touched grant.
- requirement: "§23.E: authenticate the push only through a credential helper that reads the token from env. Never print the token."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml — the three `Checkout repository` steps (855-859, 1740-1744, 2350-2354) plus the five fetch/push steps ("Commit and push report", both "Sync latest report from target branch", both section push steps)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The three checkouts pass the token without `persist-credentials: false`, and their fetch/push calls use the stored credential. Only scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh (lines 93-95) sets the one-shot GIT_CONFIG_* helper, and only deliver-report (line 2944) sets persist-credentials: false. The tests assert this only for deliver-report, and the earlier editor fix was lost.
- requirement: "A final job opens one pull request into the default branch"; fail closed with reason=run_context_invalid when DEFAULT_BRANCH is set and differs from GITHUB_REF_NAME
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh validation block (lines 65-83/65-88, `TARGET_BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"`) and the deliver-report env block in .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (lines 2951-2962; add DEFAULT_BRANCH)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The validation block never references DEFAULT_BRANCH, and the env block does not pass it. TARGET_BRANCH comes from GITHUB_REF_NAME (line 70) and is used as `--base` at line 297. deep-audit already exposes `DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch || '' }}` at line 1751. Swapping `--base` alone would pull unrelated commits into the PR. The earlier editor fix was lost.
- requirement: Run-branch path check — "any changed path that is not `analysis/workflow-optimization-<date>(-N).md`, or a diff that cannot be computed, fails closed with reason=unexpected_paths"
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh, post-worktree diff check after line 171
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The script computes no diff between the run branch and the trusted checkout before opening the PR, and test_delivery_rejects_invalid_branch_and_file covers only REPORT_BRANCH and REPORT_FILE.
- requirement: The pre-push gate lists tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py as a failure "caused by this change"
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py (test case for the new deliver-report checkout)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: There is no hunk in tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py, and the pre-push gate reports 1 failure caused by this PR.
- requirement: Changelog fragment per §20.D — 3-5 sentence lead paragraph and an audience-closing ("What this means for ...") paragraph before "For contributors"
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8963-log-analysis-report-pr-delivery.md (line 4; between the table at lines 10-13/12 and "### For contributors" at line 14)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The lead paragraph at line 4 has six (or more) sentences, and the fragment goes straight from the table to "### For contributors" with no audience-closing paragraph.

  PROBLEM: The PR body reports "Deep audit section: completed" even when the section push fails (reason=push_failed / push_rejected_by_ruleset), because audit_status is set before the push and wla_deliver_status() renders it.
  WHY: The report PR claims a section the run branch does not contain, which breaks "the PR still carries whatever completed". Fix: pass needs.deep-audit.result / needs.api-redundancy.result and print completed only on success.

  WHY: The required `lint` aggregate fails; the editor should re-run these jobs against the merge-base and not guess-fix.
